name: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash
summary: Tundra MacGrann, an injured dwarven hunter living out in the cold crags of Dun Morogh, has lost his winter supplies to a notorious local beast. A massive yeti known as Old Icebeard hauled off MacGrann's thorium-reinforced meat locker into its den. Unable to outrun the beast on a bum leg, the hunter relies on passing adventurers to slip inside and retrieve his provisions.

sections.title: Winter Stores and Stolen Lockers
sections.body: Surviving the harsh winters of Dun Morogh demands preparation, especially for mountaineers living outside the warmth of Kharanos and Ironforge. Tundra MacGrann had diligently salted away an entire month's worth of dried meats to outlast the coming cold season flurries. Taking precautions against hungry wild bears, he sealed his rations inside a reinforced thorium meat locker. Unfortunately, he did not account for the sheer brute strength of the mountain yetis, who carried the entire chest away rather than trying to open it on the spot.

sections.title: Old Icebeard's Den
sections.body: The culprit behind the theft is Old Icebeard, a feared and vicious yeti lurking in the jagged hills. While MacGrann was away hunting deer, Icebeard snatched the chest and dragged it back to his mountain cave. Though MacGrann remains confident that even a yeti cannot shatter solid thorium plating, his own injured leg makes a recovery mission suicidal. Any brave soul venturing into the cave must either contend directly with the beast or time their intrusion carefully while the monster is out prowling the snowdrifts.

faq.answer: Tundra MacGrann is a dwarven trapper and hunter dwelling in the snowy expanses of Dun Morogh. Nursing a bad leg, he depends on his harvested stores to endure the harsh winter conditions.
A menacing local yeti known as Old Icebeard stole the locker while MacGrann was away hunting deer, dragging the heavy thorium chest into its mountain lair.

faq.q: Why can't MacGrann get his meats back himself?
faq.answer: MacGrann suffers from an injured leg that severely limits his mobility. He knows he cannot move swiftly or quietly enough to enter and escape Old Icebeard's cave without being caught and mauled.

faq.q: Did the yeti eat the food?
faq.answer: No. The dried meats were locked inside a sturdy chest crafted from solid thorium. While the yeti succeeded in carrying the heavy container off, it is unable to break through the metal.

faq.q: Do you have to fight Old Icebeard to get the meat locker?
aliases: do i have to kill icebeard
faq.answer: No, you do not necessarily have to fight him. Old Icebeard regularly wanders outside his lair, giving nimble adventurers an opportunity to sneak into the cave and loot the locker unnoticed.

faq.q: Where is the stolen stash located?
faq.answer: The stolen meat locker rests deep inside Old Icebeard's mountain cave, located in the hills near MacGrann's camp in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: Fellow trackers will sympathize with MacGrann's misfortune of having months of diligent field dressing and game preservation undone by an opportunistic beast while out tracking deer.
Every dwarf in Dun Morogh knows the unforgiving brutality of a mountain winter; without preserved meat or shelter, even a hardened mountaineer cannot hold out against the freeze.
MacGrann specifically seeks out stealthy travellers, making this theft a textbook job for scouts who can slip in behind Old Icebeard's back without ever drawing a blade.
